title: EventName v1 (payload)
description: Payload inside the standard envelope (docs/events/envelope.v1.schema.json: eventId, eventType, eventVersion, tenantId, occurredAt, correlationId, payload). Governance: only additive, optional fields within v1; removing, renaming or changing the meaning of a field requires v2, published in parallel until all consumers have migrated. Partition key = the entity whose order matters (e.g. transactionId). Consumers must be idempotent on eventId.

entityId.description: Natural key; also the Kafka partition key

optionalField.description: Added later in v1 as optional; consumers must tolerate its absence
